credit: Base plinth half-slab, painted on its own 16x16 texture cbc_firecontrol:block/advanced_cannon_mount (flat Create-brass panel with corner rivets and bolt marks). Lives inside the models/block/advanced_cannon_mount/ folder together with the partials, referenced by blockstates/advanced_cannon_mount.json. Side faces use UV (0,0)-(16,8) and top/bottom (0,0)-(16,16), matching the Blockbench project .cbc_src/advanced_cannon_mount.bbmodel; because the bitmap is 16px, pixels == Java model texture units (16 units == whole sprite), so no scaling is needed and no bearing/axle art can leak onto the plinth.
